tier1.headline: Your agreement is presumed
tier1.quote: By registering at bunny.net, the user is deemed to have given consent to the processing of their personal data.

tier1.headline: Your data trains AI
tier1.quote: When using the Fluffee chat, our system leverages the OpenAI ChatGPT API to generate responses.

tier1.headline: Your income data collected
tier1.quote: When you sign up for a bunny.net account, we collect your full name, email address, and postal address.

tier2.headline: Your data shared internally
tier2.quote: Salesforce will receive billing, consumption, and service usage details.

tier2.headline: Your data retained for taxes
tier2.quote: Personal data included in tax and accounting documents will be retained for the period required under applicable tax and accounting regulations.

tier2.headline: Your behavior is analyzed
tier2.quote: This may include the name of the browser used, pages visited, and points of interest based on mouse heatmap technology.

tier2.headline: Your data crosses borders
tier2.quote: Address: BunnyWay d.o.o., Dunajska cesta 165, 1000 Ljubljana, Slovenia

tier2.headline: Your deletion rights limited
tier2.quote: The withdrawal applies only to data processed on the basis of consent.
